issues.claim: §8.8 (l. 14330–14332) applies a device-pixel-ratio change 'at once when no gesture runs, at the gesture's settle otherwise (T121-7)', with no rate limit, while the same unit's judgment J-A121.07 holds it to the loop's window — the base index row (l. 22865: 'a change Auto's loop decides while no gesture runs, and a device-pixel-ratio change, applied at once (at most once in 10 s)') and its Part A entry ('are applied at once, still at most once in 10 s') — and R4-10's binding phrase for 'Auto's or a device-pixel-ratio change's timing' ends '— and at most once in 10 s (§8.8)'. The repair's sweep wrote R4-10's phrase into §8.8's DPR sentence without its last clause. A window dragged to another monitor within 10 s of a loop change (an idle view stepped down under a weather spell, then moved): one builder applies the new DPR at once, another holds it until 10 s have passed since the last change. No bar separates them (T121-7 bars the re-evaluation only; T-ER-26's idle fixture has no change before it).
issues.required_change: §8.8's sentence reads 'A device-pixel-ratio change (the window moved to another monitor) refits d at once and is applied while the view is settled — at once when no gesture runs, at the gesture's settle otherwise — and at most once in 10 s, counted with the loop's changes, so one coming within 10 s of the last change applies when those 10 s end (T121-7)'; T-ER-26 adds the input 'a monitor change with the view idle within 10 s of a loop step-down' with the outcome 'applied within one frame of the end of the 10 s since that step-down'.

issues.claim: §11.2's new ExportOpts.links writes 'one LineString of kind supplyLink per supply link within the export's scope … (V09 §5.15)', but §11.1's GeoJSON row — the base's list of the exporter's features — names no supplyLink feature (only supplyChain, file f item 410), and V09 §5.15 (l. 4126) says 'one LineString per link in view scope': the feature is stated only in an options comment and a volume, and the two differ in form on which links it holds (the Map data export has no scope of its own, V09 §5.10).
issues.required_change: §11.1's GeoJSON row adds, after the supplyChain clause: 'with ExportOpts.links (§11.2), one LineString of kind supplyLink per supply link within the export's scope — good, consumer, provider, satisfaction, declared, as the links query reads them (§11.2), a withheld end by address and kind and a concealed use's links left out'; §11.2's links comment cites '§11.1' for the feature (V09 §5.10 for the checkbox); V09 §5.15's row (l. 4126) reads 'one LineString per link within the export's scope (§11.1; §11.2's ExportOpts.links)' (V09's end).

issues.claim: §11.2's out-of-range rule clamps 'vtt.squareM to the nearer of 1.5 and 1': a scripted 1.25 is equidistant, so two builders write a 1 m or a 1.5 m grid. A non-finite numeric member (NaN for vtt.pxPerSquare, stride or a size side, which a script or a bridged message can carry) is neither 'below 50' nor in the refusal list, so whether it clamps or refuses is unstated. Off the dialog's path (V09 §5.10 offers none), hence minor.
issues.required_change: The rule reads '… vtt.squareM to the nearer of 1.5 and 1 (1.25 to 1.5, the default) …' and adds to the refusal list 'a numeric member that is not a finite number'; T-ER-19's out-of-range list adds vtt.squareM 1.25 and a NaN vtt.pxPerSquare with those outcomes.

issues.claim: §11.2 now computes the listing at a drawn week from the frame ('read from V06 §3.15.2's frame (its Use records …; the HistoryStore images between the frame and the head)'), yet its closing sentence and §12.5's Find budget say the readers read 'the generation worker's Find index, rebuilt once per commit' (R12-35: 'the index once per commit'), while V09 §4.21.10 (7) rebuilds it also 'at each change of §2.9's week (a timeline scrub, a host's view.set { week }) and at each onEffectiveKey'. The base's trigger list omits the week and key changes its own rule needs, and no budget or timing bar covers the re-evaluation a scrub causes (T120-6 and R12-35 time a key's suggestions and a click's glow only; V06 §6.4 budgets the frame, not Find over it).
issues.required_change: §11.2's sentence reads '… read it, from the generation worker's Find index, rebuilt once per commit and at each change of the effective key (§12.5), and, at a drawn week whose frame is not the head, re-derived from that frame at each change of §2.9's week (V09 §4.21.10 (7))'; §12.5's Find paragraph adds 'a change of the drawn week re-evaluates the chips' listing (§11.2's At a drawn week) off the scrub's path, within ≈ 100 ms of the frame being drawn at the METROPOLIS cap (V06 §6.4), the frame never waiting for it'; R12-35's row and T120-6 add that timing.

issues.claim: §8.1 now declares Box among the types 'declared in @plat/model (§14), so @plat/labels and @plat/render share them', and labels' own ObstacleSource (§14 l. 19654–19655) takes Box, but §14's @plat/model line (l. 19396: 'the shared view vocabulary LodBand, Role, ZoomStop and the label-row tables'), its dependency rule (l. 19529: 'the types both use (LodBand, Role, ZoomStop, LabelEntity, the label-row tables and LabelRows) come from model') and the type index (l. 19662: 'LodBand, Role, ZoomStop, LabelTable, StringTable, GeomTable: §8.1, §8.2, §8.8') name no Box.
issues.required_change: Each of the three lists adds Box after LodBand: 'the shared view vocabulary LodBand, Box, Role, ZoomStop …'; '(LodBand, Box, Role, ZoomStop, LabelEntity, …)'; 'LodBand, Box, Role, ZoomStop, LabelTable, StringTable, GeomTable: §8.1, §8.2, §8.8'.

issues.claim: T121-3 (§13.8 l. 18583) reads 'over §12.5's reference views'; the canon's G-refview retires 'reference view' for 'reference viewport' (§12.5's home), and every other site in the set now reads 'reference viewport(s)' (repair-r4-rendering's hand-off named this site).

§7.7 (l. 11873–11874): 'the host's commands (§11.3: a week and a selection by view.set, the layers shown by a logged setLayer …)'. Under R4-02 a host's layer command sets a layer's visibility, while the view draws its working layer whatever its visibility (§8.4); §11.3 and T-ER-21 now say 'a layer's visibility'. A restatement left in the older form.
issues.required_change: The parenthesis reads '(§11.3: a week and a selection by view.set, a layer's visibility by a logged setLayer sent by doc.apply, as a user's toggle)'.

issues.claim: V08 l. 489 (setView's comment: 'the layers shown go as a logged setLayer by doc.apply (§8.4)'), l. 2450 and l. 2521 ('A host sets the frame's view only by §11.3's commands — view.set { week }, view.set { select } and the layers shown by a logged setLayer') restate §11.3 in its pre-R4-02 form; setLayer writes the document's style, not the frame's view, and the frame draws its working layer whatever its visibility (§8.4).
issues.required_change: l. 489 reads 'a layer's visibility goes as a logged setLayer by doc.apply (§8.4)'; l. 2450 and l. 2521 read '… view.set { week } and view.set { select }, and a layer's visibility by a logged setLayer sent by doc.apply (the document's style, §8.4) …'.

issues.claim: R4-04 (a) makes 'the look's units (§10.2 (d))' the one phrase, never 'district' alone at the village rungs, and §8.2's ruinTone lies on 'a unit's faces — a district's, or at the village rungs its unit's plots''. §10.2 (d)'s footprint exception (l. 15650: 'a disaster's ruins and its districts' tone') and CrisisLookRow.lookLevel's comment (l. 15277: 'the decay level its districts' buildings draw') still say districts (repair-r4-rendering's hand-off named the first).
issues.required_change: l. 15650 reads 'a disaster's ruins and its units' tone (§8.2's ruinTone)'; l. 15277 reads 'the disaster row only: item 123's decay level the buildings it stands over draw ((f)) at severity 0 and 1, linear between'.
